description: Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) and Occupational Outlook Handbook (OOH) data. Includes metro-area employment/wage data for SF Bay Area MSAs (via BLS API) and national occupation statistics (scraped from BLS HTML tables).

years_covered.oews_national_data: May 2023 (HTML scrape - 2024 national HTML requires interactive viewer)

bls_api_v2.notes: v2 API without registration key: 25 requests/day, 50 series/request. Rate limited after ~14 batch requests. v1 shares the same IP-based limit.

bls_html_scrape.note: May 2024 national data only available at interactive viewer (data.bls.gov/oes/), not as static HTML. BLS XLSX download links blocked by Akamai CDN (403 Forbidden to all curl/programmatic requests).

ooh_occupation_finder.note: Occupational Outlook Handbook with projected growth rates and education requirements

oews_data_2024.json.description: Comprehensive OEWS data: May 2024 for SF-Oakland and San Jose MSAs (BLS API), May 2023 for National (HTML scrape). Includes 23 major occupation groups + ~40 detailed occupations per area.

ooh_occupation_outlook.json.description: BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook data with projected growth rates, education requirements, and median pay ranges for ~41 key occupations.

fetch_bls_data.py.description: Python script to fetch OEWS data from BLS API v2. Configurable for different areas and occupations.

assemble_data.py.description: Data assembly script that combines API results, HTML-scraped national data, and OOH data.

parse_bls_html.py.description: Helper module for parsing BLS HTML table data.

metadata.json.description: This file - data provenance and manifest.

san_jose_msa.note: San Jose has the highest mean wages in the nation for software developers ($226,510) and IT managers ($319,480)

national_context.note: National data is May 2023; 2024 not yet available as downloadable file
